item.title: Abandoned bin still not collected, 26th November
item.description:
I reported an abandoned and upturned bin in September (Fix my street ref: 10116358) and it remains uncollected. Someone has kindly lifted the bin upright but it now has dog mess bags on top. I assume some more bags are now inside. https://w3w.co/change.drip.avoid

item.title: Ash Tree located on highway land problem, 26th November
item.description:
I live at the Gazebo, Upper Dowdeswell. We have a tree on the corner, next to the road, just outside our property. This is a very big ash, showing signs of dieback. Could I ask if you could have a look at it please. If you need any further info please let me know.
Report on FixMyStreet
